newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat shares gain on metalworker talks hope.
newsitem.headline: Fiat shares gain on metalworker talks hope.

text.p: Shares in Italian industrial group Fiat extended gains on Monday on optimism that a deal might soon be reached between Italy's engineering and metalworker unions and employers, dealers said.
At 1445 GMT, Fiat shares were quoted up 2.1 percent at 5,245 lire in a lower Milan market after hitting a day's high of 5,355 lire with some 13.7 million shares traded.

Earlier today, Labour Minister Tiziano Treu said he believed a new government proposal to end the metalworkers' pay dispute would be acceptable to both unions and employers following all-night talks between union employers and government.

Analysts said that after Fiat announced preliminary 1996 results on Thursday showing a fall in operating profits, most of the comments surrounding Fiat were negative. But some now saw Fiat shares as good value considering the Italian government's car buying incentive scheme.
